system.description:
The street brawlers of the Mournas underground and Opal's docks: a scrapper who fights dirty and fights smart.

  • Street Fighter: once per round while raging, when you hit, you may also make a Dirty Trick against that creature as part of the hit.
    • 9th level: you have Advantage on that Dirty Trick.
  • Underground Network: Advantage on checks to navigate a city's underworld, read gang or faction markings, or find allies among its criminals.
